_comment: Persistent line membership (#819, docs/acies-triplex-design.md phase 2): four player Spearmen units spawn already spaced out just above the drag line, get box-selected, then a right-to-left checkerboard drag (form_up_dist=4, CHECKERBOARD) splits them into a front line and an offset rear line. That interaction is exactly where Unit.line_index gets stamped -- SelectionManager._checkerboard_slices tags each slice's line, Battle.enqueue_form_up carries it through, and Battle._apply_order_cmd writes it onto the unit (scripts/Battle.gd, scripts/SelectionManager.gd, scripts/Unit.gd). The persistent line state itself has no render path yet (Phase 1 of #819 is bookkeeping only -- the flank-vulnerability and century-withdrawal mechanics that will read it are still to come), so this clip shows the visible half of the interaction (the checkerboard deploy) and the line-index bookkeeping it exercises is verified separately by test/unit/test_acies_triplex_line_membership.gd, test_battle.gd's line-index cases, and test_unit_card_tray.gd's line-index cases -- not by anything in this recording. drill:true (no team 1) since this is a pure maneuver demo. Static wide camera covering the whole spawn-to-settle span, no easing.

shape_residual.reason: Four 100-man Spearmen units execute a simultaneous multi-unit checkerboard form-up into two offset lines, transiently distorting during the crossing and line decomposition before settling.

path_crossing.reason: Soldier paths transiently intersect while the multi-unit line splits into front/rear checkerboard positions before forming up.
